source: Pension Reform Act 2014 (Act No. 4 of 2014), section 4(1), gazetted copy read 2026-11-05 (http://ngfrepository.org.ng:8080/jspui/bitstream/123456789/968/1/PENSION%20REFORM%20ACT%202014%20-%20GAZETTED%20COPY.pdf, National Assembly repository; scanned pages): the contribution is a minimum of 10% by the employer and a minimum of 8% by the employee, on monthly emoluments; the rates may be revised upwards by agreement (4(2)). Section 120: monthly emoluments are the total emoluments defined in the contract of employment, and not less than basic salary plus housing allowance plus transport allowance. The 8% here is the statutory minimum; the input is the sum of basic, housing and transport, or more if the contract says so. Employer share is a separate cost. The employee's contribution is deductible for income tax under section 30(2)(a)(iii) of the Nigeria Tax Act 2025.
